ruleset.name: comments
ruleset.description: Comments explain a non-obvious why in a few lines, and describe the code as it is, not how it came to be.

rule.message: History or process wording in a comment: it belongs in the commit message

property.name: forbiddenRegex
property.value: (?i)\b(previously|no longer|used to|originally|discovered|turned out|surfaced (while|when)|caught by|verified (by|against|empirically)|before switching|we found|was (changed|fixed|added|removed|renamed))\b
